question: RA1 inter-coder span-overlap agreement on the first 1973 lot (5 speeches) is 0.097, well below the 0.6 escalation threshold. Is this expected cold-start noise (empty grid, no shared vocabulary yet) or a sign the lot size / prompt needs adjustment before running the full batch?
interpretations: Expected: with zero existing codes, two independent instances will naturally fragment differently on the very first lot; agreement should rise once a shared grid exists from lot 2 onward.
Concerning: lot size of 5 may be too small/heterogeneous (5 very different countries: LBN, BHR, GAB, OMN, SAU) for two coders to converge on the same salient passages at all.
recommendation: Proceed with the next lot using the now-shared grid from lot 1 and re-check reliability before deciding whether to adjust lot composition or size.
